programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 5 for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))]
    r_bounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    r_parts = [(r_bounds[i] + 1, r_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(r_bounds) - 1)]
    c_parts = [(c_bounds[i] + 1, c_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(c_bounds) - 1)]
    sr0, sr1 = r_parts[-1]
    sc0, sc1 = c_parts[-1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in r_parts:
        for c0, c1 in c_parts:
            if (r1-r0, c1-c0) != (sr1-sr0, sc1-sc0):
                continue
            for r in range(r1-r0):
                for c in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+r][c0+c] = grid[sr0+r][sc0+c]
    return out
'''
